name: Mitchell Troyanovsky
bio: Mitchell Troyanovsky is the co-founder of Basis, an agentic AI company recently valued at $1.15 billion and backed by BTV, Khosla, Accel and GV. Mitch is building the first long-horizon agents capable of independently executing complex, end-to-end financial workflows — like partnership tax returns — for hours or even days at a time.

sessions.title: Process Supervision for Agents That Do Long-Horizon Work
